thread.title: Common Lift/Tire Combo's for OBS/NBS Trucks & SUVs
thread.first_post_html:
These are only common lift/tire combinations that seem to work well together. Some setups may rub in off-highway situations, but most allow for clearance. Any wheel that is 'not recommended' for that particular height can be run, but is not advisable.

Metric Tire Size Conversion

OBS Trucks (88-98), OBS SUVs (92-99):

Stock height
- 285/75R16 & 32/11.5R15 on Stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (possible torsion bar crank); 16x10/15x10 not recommended
- 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on Stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

3" Suspenion Lift or Body Lift
- 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8; 16x10/15x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares); 16x10/15x10 not recommended

4" Suspension Lift
- 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8; 16x10/15x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10/15x10 (cutout flares)

6" Total Lift (3" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift or 6" Suspension Lift)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8; 16x10/15x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10/15x10 not recommended

7" Total Lift (4" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10
- 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

9" Total Lift (6" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10
- 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10
- 38/15.5R16 & 38/15.5R15 on 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and light trimming)

NBS Trucks (99-03), NBS SUVs (00-03):

Stock height
- 285/75R16 on Stock wheels or 16x8 (possible torsion bar crank); 16x10 not recommended
- 305/70R16 on Stock wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

3" Suspenion Lift or Body Lift
- 305/70R16 and under on Stock Wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares); 16x10 not recommended

4" Suspension Lift
- 305/70R16 and under on Stock Wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10 (cutout flares)

6" Total Lift (3" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift or 6" Suspension Lift)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 36/12.5R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10 not recommended

7" Total Lift (4" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels, 16x8, or 16x10
- 36/12.5R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

9" Total Lift (6" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels, 16x8, or 16x10
- 36/12.5R16 on Stock Wheels, 16x8, or 16x10
- 38/15.5R16 on 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming)



*Note:Thanks to those who double-checked everything and added more info.

thread.title: Common Lift/Tire Combo's for OBS/NBS Trucks & SUVs

rewrite.rewritten_title: Common Lift/Tire Combinations for OBS/NBS Trucks & SUVs
rewrite.summary: This article compiles common lift/tire combinations for Obsidian (OBS) and New Body Structure (NBS) trucks and SUVs, ranging from stock height to a total of 9 inches of lift. It provides guidance on tire sizes suitable for different lifts and offers insights into potential clearance issues.
seo_outline: Common Lift/Tire Combinations for OBS Trucks/SUVs
Common Lift/Tire Combinations for NBS Trucks/SUVs
rewrite.rewritten_article_markdown:
These are only common lift/tire combinations that seem to work well together. Some setups may rub in off-highway situations, but most allow for clearance. Any wheel that is 'not recommended' for that particular height can be run, but is not advisable.

### Common Lift/Tire Combinations for OBS Trucks/SUVs (88-98, 92-99)

#### Stock Height
- 285/75R16 & 32/11.5R15 on Stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (possible torsion bar crank); 16x10/15x10 not recommended
- 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on Stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

#### 3" Suspension Lift or Body Lift
- 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8; 16x10/15x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares); 16x10/15x10 not recommended

#### 4" Suspension Lift
- 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8; 16x10/15x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10/15x10 (cutout flares)

#### 6" Total Lift (3" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift or 6" Suspension Lift)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8; 16x10/15x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming) 
- 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10/15x10 not recommended

#### 7" Total Lift (4" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10
- 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

#### 9" Total Lift (6" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10
- 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on Stock Wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10
- 38/15.5R16 & 38/15.5R15 on 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and light trimming)

### Common Lift/Tire Combinations for NBS Trucks/SUVs (99-03, 00-03)

#### Stock Height
- 285/75R16 on Stock wheels or 16x8 (possible torsion bar crank); 16x10 not recommended
- 305/70R16 on Stock wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

#### 3" Suspenion Lift or Body Lift
- 305/70R16 and under on Stock Wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares); 16x10 not recommended

#### 4" Suspension Lift
- 305/70R16 and under on Stock Wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10 (cutout flares)

#### 6" Total Lift (3" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift or 6" Suspension Lift)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (possible torsion bar crank and light trimming) 
- 36/12.5R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10 not recommended

#### 7" Total Lift (4" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels, 16x8, or 16x10 
- 36/12.5R16 on Stock Wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares)

#### 9" Total Lift (6" Suspension Lift + 3" Body Lift)
- 315/75R16 on Stock Wheels, 16x8, or 16x10 
- 36/12.5R16 on Stock Wheels, 16x8, or 16x10 
- 38/15.5R16 on 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming)

*Note: Thanks to those who double-checked everything and added more info.

post_rewrites.rewritten_content:
These are common lift/tire combinations that work well for OBS Trucks/SUVs (88-98) and NBS Trucks/SUVs (99-03). Some setups may experience rubbing, but most allow adequate clearance.

For OBS models:
- Stock height: 285/75R16 & 32/11.5R15 on stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (possible torsion bar crank); 16x10/15x10 not recommended.
- 3" lift: 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares).
- 4" lift: 305/70R16 & 33/12.5R15 on stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming).
- 6" lift: 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 16x10/15x10 (cutout flares).
- 7" lift: 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on stock wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10; 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on stock wheels or 16x8/15x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares).
- 9" lift: 315/75R16 & 35/12.5R15 on stock wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10; 36/12.5R16 & 36/12.5R15 on stock wheels, 16x8/15x8, or 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming); 38/15.5R16 & 38/15.5R15 on 16x10/15x10 (torsion bar crank and light trimming).

For NBS models:
- Stock height: 285/75R16 on stock wheels or 16x8 (possible torsion bar crank); 16x10 not recommended.
- 3" lift: 305/70R16 and under on stock wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (torsion bar crank and light trimming) - 315/75R16 on stock wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares).
- 4" lift: 305/70R16 and under on stock wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (torsion bar crank and light trimming) - 315/75R16 on stock wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming).
- 6" lift: 315/75R16 on stock wheels or 16x8; 16x10 (torsion bar crank and light trimming) - 36/12.5R16 on stock wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming).
- 7" lift: 315/75R16 on stock wheels, 16x8, or 16x10; 36/12.5R16 on stock wheels or 16x8 (torsion bar crank and light trimming); 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming, or cutout flares).
- 9" lift: 315/75R16 on stock wheels, 16x8, or 16x10; 36/12.5R16 on stock wheels, 16x8, or 16x10 - 38/15.5R16 on 16x10 (torsion bar crank and heavy trimming).

For a 2001 Tahoe Z71 with 17-inch wheels, you have the following options:

For my 97 Yukon with a 6+3 suspension and current 36x14.5R15 tires, I plan to switch to 38.5x15.5R15 tires as Tennessee did, but I'm experiencing rubbing. Should I adjust the backspacing, crank the T-bars, or flip the ball joints? The angles appear correct. Any advice would be appreciated.

What size wheel? I'm guessing 15x10. Determine if the rubbing occurs on flat ground with the wheels fully locked or when flexed at full lock. The best approach is to identify where the rub is happening, assess its severity, and then gradually adjust by trimming a little at a time.
